projectDir.description: Directory holding the project, relative to the directory the CLI runs in.

version-declared.name: Java version is declared
version-declared.description: The build declares the Java release it compiles for, and that release is no older than the configured floor.

minVersion.description: Oldest Java release accepted, as a release number such as `17`. A declared release below this is a violation.

toolchain-declared.name: Java toolchain is declared
toolchain-declared.description: The build selects the JDK it compiles with through a Java toolchain, instead of using whichever JDK launched it.

version-reproducible.name: Java version is reproducible
version-reproducible.description: The Java release is declared through a mechanism that provisions the JDK, not one that asks the running JDK to target an older release.
